name: chatgpt2api
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 3; done; cd /workspaces/chatgpt2api; if [ ! -f AUTH_KEY.txt ]; then python3 -c "import secrets;open(\"AUTH_KEY.txt\",\"w\").write(secrets.token_hex(24))"; fi; python3 -c "import json,os;c=json.load(open(\"config.json\"));c[\"auth-key\"]=open(\"AUTH_KEY.txt\").read().strip(); cn=os.environ.get(\"CODESPACE_NAME\"); c[\"base_url\"]=(\"https://\"+cn+\"-3000.app.github.dev\") if cn else \"\"; json.dump(c,open(\"config.json\",\"w\"),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)"; docker compose up -d; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 5; done'
